messages:
Sam: Hey @Priya — kicking off the Luminate onboarding thread. Quick sync: want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and an initial 30/60 timeline. Can you confirm who from your side will own integration + privacy?
Priya (Luminate): Hi Sam! Thanks — I'll own product integration. I'll loop in Maya for security/compliance and Arjun for data.
Jordan: re: integration — we usually start with sandbox API keys + a sample dataset. Jordan here (SE) — can you share someone who can run the initial tests?
Priya (Luminate): Arjun can run tests. He prefers a short runbook.
Li: quick note on timelines — proposed milestones: Week 1: sandbox + auth; Week 2: ingest & sample flows; Week 4: UAT and success criteria review. Is that OK? :calendar:
Sam: That timeline looks good. For success criteria, recommend: 1) end-to-end sample flow with <90ms median inference in staging, 2) <2% regression vs baseline on our eval prompts, 3) internal docs & runbook handed off. Thoughts?
Priya (Luminate): Those are reasonable. Might add: data retention policy confirmed and SOC2 scoping for renewal.
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist created: /onboard/luminate/steps — owners set to Sam, Jordan, Li.
Jordan: For Arjun — sample cURL to hit sandbox (feel free to paste into a quick script):
```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small", "input":"Hello"}'
```
Jordan: Also will provision a small test dataset and a prebuilt eval suite (will add to the checklist).
Priya (Luminate): Great — I'll have Arjun run the cURL tomorrow and share outcomes. Maya will ping Sam on compliance questions by EOD.
Sam: Perfect. Next steps for us: 1) Jordan to provision sandbox keys by EOD tomorrow, 2) Sam to schedule 30-min kickoff with Maya/Arjun, 3) Li to add the Week 4 UAT slot in the shared calendar. I'll post the calendar invite here when scheduled. :thumbsup:
Priya (Luminate): Thanks everyone — excited to get started.
Sam: Invite posted: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 — kickoff Tue 10am PT. See you then!
Priya (Luminate): Confirmed.
Li: Logged risk: if SOC2 scoping drags >3 weeks we may shift renewal enablement. Marked as medium.
Sam: Noted — we'll track in the onboarding tracker and flag weekly. Thanks all! :rocket:
